title: Find what was said in an earlier conversation
earlier: Quick question while I plan the night: the customer asked us to move the billing cutover to 02:40 UTC under ticket ZX-4471. How much notice do customers usually get for a cutover?
prompt: In an earlier conversation I asked you a question about the billing cutover and gave a ticket number for it. Find that ticket number and write it into ANSWER.txt, alone on one line.
